items.q: He has billed himself as someone willing to break from his party on immigration, pledging to “secure our border.”

items.t: Voted no on the state budget that created Arizona's Border Security Fund (2022).
items.q: In 2022, I sponsored HB 2492 to require proof of citizenship to register to vote in Arizona, and Shah voted no. That same year he voted against the state budget that created Arizona's Border Security Fund

items.t: Proposed a bill to subsidize health insurance premiums for teachers who make $75,000 or less and have dependents.
items.q: teachers facing high premiums for their dependents can’t resort to insuring them under the state’s low income KidsCare option, because it bars coverage for those who qualify for insurance through a state agency employee. His bill would remedy that for teachers who make $75,000 or less and whose schools can prove that subsidizing their premiums would be a retention factor.
